question: The Carnatic classical vocalist and first ever musician to receive the Bharat Ratna award, also known as ‘Queen of songs’, is _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Subbulakshmi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** was a renowned Carnatic classical vocalist and the first musician to receive the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• She is often referred to as the **'Queen of songs'** due to her exceptional talent and contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• Her music has had a significant impact on the world of Carnatic music, earning her a place of high respect and admiration.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi's performances were not only popular in India but also internationally, making her a global icon for Indian classical music.
 
• She also received several other prestigious awards, including the Ramon Magsaysay award for public service through music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subbulakshmi** was born on September 16, 1916, in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was trained in Carnatic music from a very young age and gave her first public performance at the age of eleven.
 
• Her rendition of the Bhajans and classical compositions have left an indelible mark on the hearts of music lovers.
 
• She was also known for her philanthropic activities, contributing significantly to various social causes.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi passed away on December 11, 2004, but her legacy continues to inspire and influence musicians worldwide.
